description: Lausanne Cathedral crowns the Cité hill, a Gothic church with flying buttresses and a single completed belfry above the old-town roofs, with Lake Geneva beyond. The west front was planned with two towers, and only the belfry was finished, so the skyline is not a twin-tower facade. The painted portal is not shown close up, Chillon is a separate Montreux scene, and no scaffolding is added. The Open-Meteo model sets the light.
